description: Use for "does cannabis help with ...": conditions on the atlas evidence ladder (substantial, moderate, limited, insufficient, evidence of no benefit): the grade and why, the systematic reviews and trials behind it by PubMed identifier, the compounds and body structures involved and the atlas page. Trials are kept as administered in each trial; doses are left out on purpose. Educational reference, not medical advice. Not a diagnostic or dosing tool.

grade.description: Only conditions with this evidence grade.

query.description: Part of a condition name, for example "epilepsy", "pain" or "sleep". Leave out to list all.

name: search_conditions
title: Search conditions by evidence grade
